about: Hand-written vectors for the evaluator's enclosures (Principia.Form.Interval, Principia.Form.Arithmetic), run by Tests/Form.lean like eval_form's cases. Each expectation was computed independently of the Lean code: Python's decimal module at 120 significant digits (exp, ln, sqrt and powers), pi by Machin's formula in decimal, sin and cos by their Taylor series in decimal after reduction by whole turns; the value rounded once to twelve significant digits, ties to even, laid out as C's %.12g. OWED: the Calculator must not answer (a value exactly zero but not known so, or tan at an odd multiple of pi/2).
